switch-display: fix WS monitor assigment

Fixes issue where workspaces was moved to a different monitor than what
assigned in config. The reason is that my displays all have a slightly
different wakeup time, and hyprland will rearrange ws on display
changes and if a display isn't available (yet) it will move it to the
best available. Calling reload again will not fix this, so I had to
force it.

This disabled toggle, I don't use it, re-implement if needed.

full usage instructions, or -h.

switch-display: hack fix for monitor WS assignment

Keep having hot plug issues with my main monitor, VRR and slow wakeup
results in workspaces being shifted to faster wakeup monitors. I need
most ws to be on main, so this hack will shift all workspace back. It's
not perfect but it's better than not doing it. Hopefully there will be
an upstream fix for this.
